from datetime import datetime, timedelta
now = datetime.now()
yesterday = now - timedelta(days=1)
weekday = yesterday.strftime('%A').lower()
yesterday_str = yesterday.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
print('now', now)
print('yesterday', yesterday_str, 'weekday', weekday)

# Plan note content already fetched earlier, but fetch again to keep deterministic
access_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='william_mart@gmail.com', password='Q&82nfd')['access_token']
plan_note_id = 2235
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=plan_note_id, access_token=access_token)
content = note['content']

# Extract duration_mins for matching day by simple parsing
lines = content.splitlines()
current_day = None
duration = None
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    s = line.strip()
    if s.startswith('day:'):
        current_day = s.split('day:')[1].strip().lower()
    if s.startswith('duration_mins:') and current_day == weekday:
        duration = int(s.split('duration_mins:')[1].strip())
        break

print('matched day', weekday, 'duration_mins', duration)
